chapters.line_en: About 38 rejections and a first commission cheque of RM 28. Finding the why that everything else is built on.
chapters.line_zh: 大約38次拒絕，第一張佣金支票只有RM 28。找到撐起一切的「為什麼」。

chapters.line_en: A RM 13,500 lesson in market research, and why knowing your weaknesses matters more than your strengths.
chapters.line_zh: 一堂學費RM 13,500的市場研究課，以及為什麼認清弱點比認清優勢更重要。

chapters.line_en: Seven specific actions, every day, for 90 days.
chapters.line_zh: 7項具體動作，每天執行，持續90天。

chapters.line_en: From about 5% to about 70% with one framework: FORMHD.
chapters.line_zh: 一個框架，讓成功率從大約5%提升到大約70%：FORMHD。

chapters.line_en: One bad invitation nearly cost a friendship of many years.
chapters.line_zh: 一次糟糕的邀約，差點毀了一段多年的友誼。

chapters.line_en: 60 slides, 2 hours, nothing sold. Then 8 slides, mostly listening, and 2 of 3 bought.
chapters.line_zh: 60張投影片、2小時，沒有人買。後來改用8張、大部分時間在聽，3個人裡2個當場買了。

chapters.line_en: She threw him out of her house. A few visits later, Aunty Lim bought the whole set.
chapters.line_zh: 她把他趕出門。去了幾次之後，Aunty Lim整套產品當場付清。

chapters.line_en: The first three days decide whether a new partner becomes a diamond or a shooting star.
chapters.line_zh: 前三天，決定新夥伴成為「鑽石」還是「流星」。

chapters.line_en: A 90-day goal of 50. 44 people in 75 days. The Five Virtues of a General.
chapters.line_zh: 90天目標50人，75天約到44位夥伴。將者五德。

chapters.line_en: RM 1,600 flight. 50 interested people. Zero results. Then Seremban.
chapters.line_zh: RM 1,600的機票，50個「有興趣」的人，零結果。直到芙蓉。

chapters.line_en: 5 of 7 core leaders left in one month. How Vivian's team came back stronger.
chapters.line_zh: 一個月內7位核心走了5位。Vivian的團隊如何比危機前更強。

chapters.line_en: Build a business that runs without you every day, and get your time back.
chapters.line_zh: 建立一個不依賴你日常運作的事業，把時間還給自己。
